entities.name: Cisarzim
entities.description: Lord of Chaos and parun of the Gruul Clans who took part in the Signing of the Guildpact; wielded the axe Skullhammer.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Guild led by a parun in Cisarzim's time.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: Present-day guildmaster of the Gruul, allegedly Cisarzim's descendant.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Parun of the Golgari Swarm who integrated Cisarzim's torso into his corpse-body.

events.summary: Cisarzim, parun of the Gruul Clans, participated in the Signing of the Guildpact.
events.quote: participated in the Signing of the Guildpact

events.summary: After Cisarzim died, Svogthir of the Golgari integrated his torso into his own corpse-body.
events.quote: the parun of the Golgari Swarm , Svogthir , integrated his torso into his corpse-body

relations.note: He was the parun of the Gruul Clans.
relations.quote: was the parun of the Gruul Clans
He is allegedly the ancestor of Borborygmos
